fields.description:
## Source of truth

https://jumpr.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/JK/pages/269090817/03+User+Stories+Jira+Disposition

## Outcome

Define Closed as a longer-term operational stop that reuses the Archived locked-state restrictions where practical, but keeps the Deal reactivatable and keeps its makeup reserved.

## Enter Closed

Through a controlled Close Deal action:

* show confirmation;
* Status → Closed;
* stamp Closed Date + Effective End Date through shared lifecycle tracking;
* keep raw Makeup Key reserved;
* apply the common locked-state business-field restrictions used by Archived where practical;
* mark all currently Active Affiliate Links inactive;
* queue the resulting Deal snapshot to CMS;
* do not alter DRAs.

**Confirmation copy:**

> Closing this Deal will lock it and mark all currently active Affiliate Links inactive in Salesforce. The changes will be queued to the CMS. Reactivating the Deal will not automatically reactivate its Affiliate Links.

## Reactivate from Closed

* Show Reactivate only to permitted users using practical Permission Set/action visibility.
* Status → Active.
* Shared lifecycle logic clears Effective End Date.
* Makeup remains the same Deal/External Deal ID.
* Affiliate Links remain inactive in V1; do not restore the pre-close active set automatically.
* Do not alter DRAs.
* Queue CMS sync.

## Closed vs Archived

Shared:

* normal business fields locked;
* system/integration/audit fields may still update;
* end-state date behavior;
* active Links are shut off.

Different:

* Closed keeps makeup reserved.
* Closed can Reactivate.
* Archived releases makeup and never uses normal Reactivate.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Close locks normal business editing but preserves system/integration updates.
2. Close stamps Closed Date + Effective End Date.
3. Active Links become inactive; already inactive Links stay inactive.
4. Close does not change DRAs.
5. Closed keeps the raw Makeup Key reserved.
6. Closed → Active clears Effective End Date.
7. Closed → Active does not automatically reactivate Affiliate Links in V1.
8. Archived has no Reactivate action.
